qualificationSuite: SECP-SECURITY-008 Test and Production Boundary Isolation Audit

findings.details: src/test/setup.ts globally invokes initializeAuthorityHandshake() for all test files. While this enables unit tests to run, it bypasses boot-time authentication testing in test runs unless tests explicitly isolate or reset authority state.

Production entry points do not import or invoke initializeAuthorityHandshake() or SealingAuthorizationBoundary. Test authority credentials and boot bypasses do not leak into the production web bundle.
Production callers properly request contextual capabilities via issueSealingCapability and pass them to sealBinding. No hardcoded authority master secrets exist in source.

recommendation: Introduce an explicit test harness reset helper in src/test/setup.ts so security tests can specifically assert uninitialized boot behavior without interference from global test setup.
